releaseNotes: New: HTML Dashboard V2 - P6-style WBS/Gantt planning workspace
WBS hierarchy depth now derived from the real parent tree (deep hierarchies no longer export flat)
P6 Classic multicolor grouping bands (default) + new P6 Subtle restrained profile; custom WBS styles preserved
Level selector (default Level 2), Expand/Collapse All, compact planner rows
Go to Data Date, Data Date and Today lines, ISO week numbers, new Quarter timescale
P6 summary brackets, critical/baseline/milestone bars, synchronized table-Gantt scrolling
Filtering keeps the full WBS ancestor chain; column layout persists; Table/Gantt/Combined print modes
Executive page: primary schedule KPIs, Planned vs Actual variance, Earned Value snapshot, compact project details
Single-file offline reports; Arabic/English mixed schedules supported
